title: Buddy Petit playing second under Toca
summary: Petit could not get jobs, so he accepted second trumpet in Milton's band; Milton also worked with Celestin.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Buddy Bolden and Buddy Petit: the trumpet legends

blocks.x: One time George Lewis told me that Lawrence Toka, hip hop, one time played something like Buddy Petit.
It's no wonder if he played, Buddy Petit played with him second company. That's right.
I didn't know they played together. Yeah, Buddy played with us a long time.
I thought Lawrence Toka was a good deal younger than Buddy Petit.
Oh, he is. Lawrence way younger than me. Yeah. Lawrence way younger than me.

Yeah. You see, why hire Buddy Petit? Nobody didn't want to hire him no more. I mean, in other words, he couldn't get no job. I heard he wasn't very reliable sometimes. That's when he came to Aquaman during the A-Mone, one day they lined my chance. I told him, I said, I got a first trumpet player. I said, if you want to play second, I mean, well, he said, that would be alright when he came in and worked with me a long time playing second trumpet.
This is where Papa Stamson did with me. When he got family, he forgot I was living.
That's the way it is. That's the way it is. That's right. That's right. That's the way them fellas is. I worked with Celestine a while too. I mean, I worked with him a while.
